c1_lot_cost.metric: price of one board lot (100 shares) as % of a 20M VND account

c2_options.metric: annualised tracking error vs the VN30 price index, daily returns × √252

c3_pitch_weights.scope: one decision on 2026-10-01, 20M VND, no real estate, banking ≤ 30%

c3_pitch_kpis.metric: estimated tracking error (250-day covariance before the date, annualised); invested % of pre-trade NAV

c3_pitch_trades.scope: 2026-10-01; cash after fees 5002538 VND; post-trade NAV 19977538 VND

checks.rule: no excluded stock or sector held

c4_accounts.metric: realised annualised tracking error vs VN30, %
c4_accounts.scope: 12 quarterly rebalances 2024–2026, fresh cash account per size, no rules

c4_accounts_ci.metric: difference in annualised TE (pp) with 95% moving-block bootstrap CI

c4_pitch_rules.scope: 20M VND, 12 quarters, with and without the two rules

c4_pitch_ci.metric: difference in annualised TE (pp), 95% block-bootstrap CI

c5_register.metric: per qubit: continuous lots from the fractional optimum, fixed lots, warm-start probability, chosen bit

c6_circuits.metric: near-optimal solution probability per shot (%): feasible and normalised gap ≤ 5%
c6_circuits.scope: 12 quarters 2024–2026, 100M VND account, 16 qubits, exact noiseless statevector, 512 shots

a_scaling.metric: near-optimal probability per shot; enumeration and statevector seconds

a_noise.metric: success under the ESP noise model (estimate), Aer noisy simulation where run
a_noise.scope: noise-aware shallow circuit chosen on 2023, IBM Heron model (FakeKingston); no hardware run

a_knn.scope: Holdout: 22 months × 5 sizes × 3 rule types, fresh accounts
